# agentready

> Audit any website for AI-agent readiness. Get an instant score and AI-powered fix suggestions.

**Tool**: https://agentready.loopxxi.com  
**CLI**: `npx agentready yoursite.com`  
**Source**: https://github.com/Loop-XXI/agentready

## What We Check

- [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org) — the primary LLM discovery index
- [llms-full.txt](https://llmstxt.org) — full flattened site content for agents
- robots.txt — presence and AI crawler policy
- sitemap.xml — page enumeration for agents
- Structured data (JSON-LD / schema.org) — fact extraction without scraping
- OpenAPI spec — API discoverability at common paths
- MCP manifest — Model Context Protocol tool discovery
- .well-known surface — security.txt, ai-plugin.json
- RSS/Atom feed — content monitoring
- Title + meta description + Open Graph tags
- Markdown content negotiation
- HTTPS + response speed

## Usage

```
npx agentready yoursite.com
npx agentready yoursite.com --json
```

## API

```
POST https://agentready.loopxxi.com/api/audit
Content-Type: application/json
{"url": "yoursite.com"}
```

Returns full JSON audit result with scores, grades, and fix suggestions.

## Score Grades

| Grade | Score | Meaning |
|-------|-------|---------|
| A | 90–100 | Fully agent-ready |
| B | 75–89 | Strong — minor gaps |
| C | 60–74 | Functional — notable gaps |
| D | 40–59 | Partial — significant gaps |
| F | 0–39 | Not agent-ready |
